modmenu.descriptionTranslation.catcraft_: CatCraft-focused staff moderation, investigation, and chat utilities.
key.ccmc.gui.title: CatCraft Moderation Companion Settings
key.ccmc.gui.missingConfigLib: Cloth Config is required to configure CatCraft Moderation Companion.
key.ccmc.general.Timestamp.Pattern.@Tool: Timestamp format. & is the Minecraft color-code prefix; the default uses a subtle dark gray. Available values include {hour}, {minute}, and {second}.
key.ccmc.general.Timestamp.CopyToChatBar: Click a timestamp to copy the message with or without formatting.
key.ccmc.general.MessageStacking.MaxRepe: Maximum repeat counter retained by CCMC for repeated-message handling.
key.ccmc.general.StoredChatLines.@Toolti: Maximum number of chat lines and timestamp message records CCMC keeps available.
key.ccmc.catcraft.StaffRank.@Tooltip: Use one of: helper, moderator, senior moderator, administrator. CCMC hides actions above your role.
key.ccmc.catcraft.PlayerClickMode.@Toolt: normal = click a player name; ctrl = Ctrl+click; disabled = leave player-name clicks unchanged.
key.ccmc.texts.copy.launch: Click to open message copy options.
key.ccmc.texts.copy.title: Copy Message
key.ccmc.general.ChatIntegrationMode.@To: auto = yield overlapping chat features when a supported external chat processor is detected; ccmc = force CCMC timestamps/history; external = disable CCMC chat processing. Moderation tools remain active in all modes.
